title: 16th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/16/2024).
Approval of the minutes of five previous sittings (minutes Nos. 9/2024 to 13/2024).
Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Maldives Legal Profession Act (Law No. 5/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé North MP Hussain Shareef.
Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Sports, Fitness and Recreation, Abdulla Rafiu: why is the tendering of the sub-base work for the B. Kudarikilu football ground delayed?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Sports, Fitness and Recreation, Abdulla Rafiu: when will work on the football grounds in B. Kamadhoo, B. Kihaadhoo and B. Dhonfanu start and be completed?
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Manadhoo MP Husnee Mubarik.

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Law No. 2/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, introduced the Legal Profession Act amendment, questioned the Sports Minister about Baa atoll football grounds, and continued two criminal-justice bill debates.
